thread:
raj-partnerships: Heads-up — NimbusCloud AWS Marketplace PO is failing at ingest. Partner procurement refusing to move forward until we support an EDI 850 SFTP feed. Their PO also includes an export-control/data residency redline in the MSA (UK-only deployment clause). Co-marketing + press planned for Mon. Need quick triage. @ella-procurement @lucas-legal please advise. :warning:

vendor-bot: PO ingest error external_id=PO-NIM-4421 status=400 error_key=INVALID_VENDOR_ALIAS details="seller_id not resolved for alias 'redwood-eu'"

ella-procurement: I called Nimbus procurement. They absolutely require EDI 850 pushed to their SFTP for production orders. Sandbox PDF manual entry is tolerated for testing, but they won't accept manual entry as the production path. They also asked for our seller_id — do we have it?

paul-sales: PO number PO-NIM-4421, EIN 98-7654321. Nimbus claims our seller_id is `seller-123red` but in our portal alias is `redwood-europe`. Somebody needs to map alias -> seller_id on AWS side. Marketing really wants the launch; we can delay but try to avoid it.

lucas-legal: I reviewed the redlines. The Nimbus MSA redline restricts software export/localization to the UK. We cannot agree to a UK-only deployment clause. Proposed counter: 1) Export compliance warranty (we comply with applicable export laws), 2) Mutual assistance for export/regulatory requests, 3) Data residency note as a service addendum for paid private deployments. I'll prepare tracked-change bullets. If they insist on UK-only, escalate to them for commercial concession.

devin-eng: Quick tech notes — alias mapping on AWS Marketplace is a partner-portal config (1-2 clicks), but I need AWS partner console access (or the partner to update). EDI 850 on SFTP: we don't currently accept inbound EDI for marketplace flows; EDI team estimate 4 business days to enable and validate. Alternative short-term: accept a signed CSV/JSON SFTP drop with a simple adapter (48–72 hours) to simulate EDI 850. If legal signs a temporary exception for data format, I can implement the adapter and alias mapping in ~48h.

maria-ops: We can do manual PO entry into accounting for revenue recognition if legal approves an exception. Risk: manual process doesn't scale and will need reconciliation. Marketing needs go/no-go by Friday EOD to keep Monday press.

paul-sales: If we can get alias mapped + temporary adapter + legal exception, we can keep launch. I'll push Nimbus on seller console access right now.

raj-partnerships: Proposed action items: 1) Lucas to circulate a 3-bullet legal counter and exception wording by EOD (legal owner). 2) Devin to request partner console access and prep the alias map + temp adapter (engineering owner). 3) Ella to attempt manual accounting entry and raise EDI enablement ticket with Nimbus (procurement owner). 4) Paul to hold marketing if not green by Fri 17:00 PT. Confirm owners.

lucas-legal: Confirmed. I'll post the counter and a short exception template in 45m.

devin-eng: Confirmed — I'll try alias map first; will post console request link and ETA. If partner won't give access, I'll prepare the adapter and test in staging, aiming for 48h.

ella-procurement: Starting manual entry now to avoid revenue hold. Opening EDI enablement ticket with Nimbus — they quoted ~5 business days for full EDI onboarding. Sharing ticket ref when created.

maria-ops: I'll coordinate with finance for manual PO intake and reconciliation. Please tag me when manual entry is complete.

paul-sales: Calling Nimbus product ops to expedite seller_id mapping. Will report back in 30m. :phone:

raj-partnerships: Thanks team — tagging for visibility @paul-sales @ella-procurement @lucas-legal @devin-eng @maria-ops. If anyone needs a quick sync with Nimbus, I can hop on a 15m call this afternoon.

[snippet of PO payload shared by Paul]:
```json
{
  "po": "PO-NIM-4421",
  "einst": "98-7654321",
  "seller_alias": "redwood-europe",
  "seller_id_claimed": "seller-123red"
}
```

ellla-procurement: Typo — starting manual entry now (will update).

devin-eng: Alias mapping request submitted. If console access approved, I can flip mapping in <1h and deploy temp adapter to staging in ~6h.

lucas-legal: Counter and exception template posted. If Nimbus won't accept the exception, escalate and I'll propose a signed addendum for data residency for paid private deployments only.

paul-sales: Nimbus responded — partner ops confirmed they updated alias mapping. Re-test now. :white_check_mark:

vendor-bot: Re-ingest success external_id=PO-NIM-4421 status=200 details="accepted into provisioning pipeline"

maria-ops: Manual entry completed and acknowledged by finance.

raj-partnerships: Status: alias mapped + manual entry done + legal exception drafted. EDI onboarding still in progress (5bd). Marketing hold lifted for now — tentative launch stands unless Nimbus pushes back on legal. Closing loop later with final contract signature. :tada:
